description: Cancels a booking of the signed-in customer. Ask the customer to confirm first. It cancels only when that costs them nothing (an unpaid booking, or a paid one 14+ calendar days ahead, whose prepayment is refunded in full); otherwise it returns `cancelled: false` and the booking page, where the customer decides.

locale.description: Language of the texts: ru, en or pt (default en).

name: cancel_booking
title: Cancel one of my bookings
